scope: Replies to comments under own Instagram media only. Comments on other accounts are draft-only.
delete_blocked_user_comments: separate moderation workflow, not part of learning queue
rules: Do not engage with blocked usernames under any circumstance
No spam, unsolicited commercial pitches, insults or personalized harassment
Do not make up movie facts, dates or streaming availability
No unmarked spoilers and no unverified claims
No promotional links or DM invitations without owner instruction
Always allow no reply as a valid editorial decision
One reply at most per approved review; no retries after uncertain API outcome
